project.name: llm-from-scratch-lab
project.description: Decoder-only language model trained on TinyStories with a closed-form scaling/memory/latency estimator and Streamlit explorer. Key contribution: calibration study showing the JAX Scaling Book estimator is wrong by 65–154% and implementing fixes.

nodes.name: streamlit_app.py
nodes.summary: Interactive Streamlit explorer with 5 Plotly tabs: parameter count, KV cache, activation memory, decode latency frontier, and measured-vs-estimated overlay. Sidebar controls ModelSpec / RuntimeSpec / HardwareSpec.

nodes.name: model.py
nodes.summary: Decoder-only Transformer: RMSNorm, SwiGLU FFN, RoPE positional encoding, causal multi-head attention (GQA-ready), TransformerBlock (pre-norm), TransformerLM. CS336 A1-compatible state_dict keys.

nodes.name: train.py
nodes.summary: Training loop with custom AdamW optimizer, cosine LR schedule with linear warmup, gradient clipping, checkpointing, and validation perplexity. Reads YAML config, loads token streams, runs full train loop.

nodes.name: tokenizer.py
nodes.summary: Byte-level BPE tokenizer with GPT-2 pretokenization pattern. train_bpe() builds vocab+merges; Tokenizer class encodes/decodes, handles special tokens, serializes to/from JSON+txt files.

nodes.name: estimator.py
nodes.summary: Pure-Python closed-form scaling estimator. Computes: parameter count, training FLOPs, activation memory, KV cache bytes, decode latency lower bound, train time estimate, roofline intensity threshold. No torch dependency.

nodes.name: hardware.py
nodes.summary: Device catalogue with HardwareSpec entries for Apple CPU, Apple M3 Max MPS, NVIDIA T4/A10G/A100/H100. pick_device() auto-selects best available torch device.

nodes.name: plotting.py
nodes.summary: Plotly chart DataFrame helpers with provenance labels (Simulated/Measured/Hybrid). Produces DataFrames for params-vs-d_model, KV cache, activation memory curves, and measured_vs_estimated scatter.

nodes.name: profile_train.py
nodes.summary: torch.profiler harness for the MEASURED side. profile_one() times forward passes (warmup + timed steps), emits Chrome-trace JSON. sweep() runs the full seq_len × batch_size grid and writes results/local/sweep.json.

nodes.name: generate.py
nodes.summary: Greedy / temperature / top-k autoregressive generation. generate() takes model + tokenizer, produces text. Truncates context to context_length if needed.

nodes.name: data.py
nodes.summary: Dataset helpers: load_token_stream() mmaps a .npy token array, save_token_stream() writes uint16/uint32 .npy files. get_batch() stub (Phase 3).

nodes.name: kv_cache_toy.py
nodes.summary: Educational KV-cache decode. decode_with_cache() does prefill then O(1)-per-token decode by growing per-layer K/V tensors. full_recompute_decode() is the naive O(T²) baseline for comparison.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package init exposing __version__.

nodes.name: tiny_cpu.yaml
nodes.summary: Training config for CPU runs: small model (d_model=128), short context, low batch size. Used for local smoke runs on MacBook CPU.

nodes.name: tiny_mps.yaml
nodes.summary: Training config for Apple MPS (GPU) runs: larger model, longer sequences, higher batch size than CPU config.

nodes.name: estimator_defaults.yaml
nodes.summary: Default ModelSpec/HardwareSpec values for the estimator explorer.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Project manifest: hatchling build, torch/numpy/streamlit/plotly/pandas deps, ruff + mypy config, pytest settings with slow/gpu markers.

nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI: runs pytest suite on push/PR. Badge shown in README.

nodes.name: download_data.py
nodes.summary: Downloads TinyStoriesV2-GPT4 train/valid txt files (~2 GB). Skips if already present.

nodes.name: tokenize_corpus.py
nodes.summary: Trains BPE tokenizer on TinyStories corpus and encodes train/valid splits to .npy token arrays.

nodes.name: cloud_a100_sweep.py
nodes.summary: Paste-and-run benchmark sweep script for RunPod A100 cloud validation (Phase 8).

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview: three stacked artifacts (LM, estimator, calibration study). Quickstart, architecture diagram, phase status, anchor test list, layout summary.

nodes.name: technical_note.md
nodes.summary: Full calibration study writeup: where the JAX Scaling Book estimator breaks (65–154% error), four proposed fixes, two implemented, results showing MAE drop from 64% to 29%.

nodes.name: 01-when-the-estimator-breaks.md
nodes.summary: Narrative blog post version of the calibration study — shorter, story-driven.

nodes.name: test_model.py
nodes.summary: Tests for TransformerLM: output shape, causal masking, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, RoPE correctness.

nodes.name: test_estimator_anchors.py
nodes.summary: 8 anchor tests from JAX Scaling Book worked examples: 16B param check, attention fraction, 512KiB KV cache, 6.3e24 FLOPs, decode latency, Llama-3-70B shape, train_time_estimate, roofline threshold.

nodes.name: test_estimator_v2.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the v2 roofline-gated tokens/s predictor: memory-bound vs compute-bound switching, overhead floor capping.

nodes.name: test_train.py
nodes.summary: Training loop tests: AdamW step, cosine schedule shape, gradient clipping, checkpoint round-trip.

nodes.name: test_tokenizer.py
nodes.summary: Tokenizer tests: BPE train, encode/decode round-trip, special tokens, file save/load.

nodes.name: test_profile.py
nodes.summary: Tests for profile_train harness: profile_one output schema, sweep grid dimensions.

nodes.name: test_smoke.py
nodes.summary: End-to-end smoke test: builds tiny model, runs a few train steps, checks loss decreases.

nodes.name: test_app.py
nodes.summary: Streamlit app import/unit tests: plotting helpers, chart DataFrame schemas.

nodes.name: adapters.py
nodes.summary: CS336 A1 official adapter signatures so the CS336 pytest suite can be dropped in to verify against the course reference implementation.

nodes.name: TransformerLM
nodes.summary: Top-level decoder-only LM. Embeds tokens, runs N TransformerBlocks with RoPE, applies final RMSNorm, projects to vocab logits. Supports optional tied embeddings.

nodes.name: TransformerBlock
nodes.summary: Single transformer layer: pre-norm RMSNorm → CausalMHA with RoPE → residual; pre-norm RMSNorm → SwiGLU FFN → residual.

nodes.name: CausalMultiHeadAttention
nodes.summary: Causal MHA with Q/K/V/O projections and optional RoPE. Builds causal mask via torch.tril. GQA-capable via separate n_kv_heads in estimator.

nodes.name: ModelSpec
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass: d_model, d_ff, n_layers, n_heads, n_kv_heads, head_dim, vocab_size, tied_embeddings. Input to all estimator functions.

nodes.name: HardwareSpec
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass: device name, peak FLOPs/s, memory bandwidth, device memory, MFU. Used by roofline and train_time_estimate.

nodes.name: Tokenizer
nodes.summary: BPE tokenizer with encode/decode, special token handling, save/load (vocab.json + merges.txt + special_tokens.json). Merge rank dict for O(1) lookup per merge step.

nodes.name: AdamW
nodes.summary: Custom AdamW (Loshchilov & Hutter decoupled weight decay). Extends torch.optim.Optimizer; step() applies bias-corrected m/v update then decoupled WD.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README: three stacked artifacts — working LM, closed-form estimator, calibration study showing the JAX Scaling Book formula is off by 65–154%.

tour.title: The Model Core
tour.description: model.py is the architectural heart: RMSNorm + SwiGLU + RoPE + causal MHA in a pre-norm decoder-only stack. TransformerLM wraps N TransformerBlocks.

tour.title: Tokenization Pipeline
tour.description: tokenizer.py implements byte-level BPE from scratch with GPT-2 pretokenization. tokenize_corpus.py trains it on TinyStories and saves token arrays.

tour.title: Training Loop
tour.description: train.py drives the full training: custom AdamW, cosine schedule with warmup, gradient clipping, checkpoint save/load. Loss drops 245→2.87 in ~13 minutes on Apple silicon.

tour.title: Scaling Estimator (Simulated side)
tour.description: estimator.py computes parameters, FLOPs, activation memory, KV cache, decode latency, and train time entirely in pure Python using closed-form formulas from the JAX Scaling Book.

tour.title: Profiling Harness (Measured side)
tour.description: profile_train.py uses torch.profiler to time real forward passes across a seq_len × batch_size grid, writing sweep.json. This is the ground truth the estimator is calibrated against.

tour.title: Calibration Study
tour.description: technical_note.md documents exactly where the estimator breaks and why (4 proposed fixes, 2 implemented). Mean absolute error dropped from 64% to 29% after fixes.

tour.title: Interactive Explorer
tour.description: streamlit_app.py ties everything together: sidebar controls ModelSpec/RuntimeSpec/HardwareSpec, 5 Plotly tabs show simulated curves and measured-vs-estimated scatter.

tour.title: KV-Cache Demo
tour.description: kv_cache_toy.py demonstrates the principle of KV caching: naive O(T²) full-recompute baseline vs. O(1)-per-token decode_with_cache() that grows K/V tensors incrementally.

tour.title: Test Suite & CI
tour.description: 68 tests cover all modules including 8 anchor tests against JAX Scaling Book worked examples. GitHub Actions CI runs on every push.
